# PR checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows username/type/name (e.g., `alice/feature/add-runtime-cache`)
- [ ] Conventional commit in title (e.g., `feat(runtime): add persistent cache`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`npm test`)
- [ ] Typecheck passes (`npx tsc --noEmit`)
- [ ] Lint/format applied
- [ ] README/Docs updated when necessary

## Summary
Describe what this PR does and why.
